title: eSpring基金经理ChristinaWoon：散户涌入加剧波动，分散
speaker: Christina Woon

segments.en: Christina, I was going to ask you about markets like Korea and Taiwan, for example, have done quite well. What you see in this market is it's increasingly become very retail driven. When you have retail investors continue to pile into these markets domestically at a time when foreign investors are in some ways tapping out.
segments.zh: Christina，我想问一下韩国和台湾等市场表现不错。你看到这些市场越来越由散户驱动。当散户持续涌入这些国内市场，而外资却在某种程度上撤出时。

segments.en: What do you make of this dynamic? And does it raise a lot of questions about whether diversification actually is a good strategy moving forward?
segments.zh: 你怎么看这种动态？这是否引发了对分散配置是否仍是好策略的质疑？

segments.en: I absolutely agree with what you've said. I think that especially in the current markets, you have to think about diversification. A lot of people have piled into the tech trade.
segments.zh: 我完全同意你的看法。我认为在当前市场，你必须考虑分散配置。很多人涌入了科技交易。

segments.en: As I mentioned before for good reason, but if you want to ensure that you generate consistent returns and to write through this volatility, you can't just have all your eggs in one basket, which is why I think we discussed India earlier.
segments.zh: 我之前提到过，理由充分，但如果你想确保获得持续回报并度过波动，就不能把所有鸡蛋放在一个篮子里，这就是为什么我们之前讨论了印度。
